name: Duniverse full-map city and province boundaries
coordinate_reference_note: Official source-map pixel coordinates; origin at top-left; x east, y south.

generation.water_source: data/relief_elevation.js river-water mask + data/lakes.geojson lake polygons
generation.ridge_source: data/ridge_network.geojson (named mountain-range backbones, anisotropic DEM crest skeletons, and selected high-summit boundary controls)
generation.method: Across the full map, extract named mountain-range backbones and local DEM ridge crests, then guide province-constrained multi-source least-cost city partitions with ridges and mapped river corridors. High summits close to an existing city divide can become fixed-seed boundary anchors. City lines use a terrain-led source divider, gentle deterministic smoothing, and bounded relief-scaled detail; irregularity grows in rugged terrain and is damped on short segments. River and lake sections receive no random displacement. Short land-only city-line endpoints are snapped to the nearest shared city or province boundary when no river, lake, or coast is closer. Shared province boundaries are included in this layer for close-up views.
